OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.name: Prompt Injection
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.description: Manipulating a Large Language Model (LLM) through crafty inputs to execute unintended actions. Includes Direct (system prompt override) and Indirect (hidden in external files or websites) prompt injections.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.impact: Can lead to unauthorized data access, account takeover, complete system compromise, or execution of arbitrary code.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.mitigation: Enforce privilege separation, implement 'Human-in-the-Loop' for sensitive actions, and use semantic guardrails to detect malicious intent.

OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.name: Insecure Output Handling
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.description: Failing to validate or sanitize the outputs generated by the LLM before passing them to downstream components, systems, or users.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.impact: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF), Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF), or Remote Code Execution (RCE).
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.mitigation: Treat LLM output as untrusted user input. Apply strict output sanitization, encoding, and validation mechanisms.

OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.name: Training Data Poisoning
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.description: Tampering with the training data, fine-tuning datasets, or embedding malicious data to introduce vulnerabilities, backdoors, or biases into the model.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.impact: Creation of persistent backdoors in the model, degraded performance, or generation of biased and malicious outputs.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.mitigation: Verify data sources, use cryptographic signatures for datasets, apply differential privacy, and implement rigorous data cleaning.

OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.name: Model Denial of Service
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.description: Adversaries causing the LLM to consume excessive resources (CPU, memory, API calls) by providing unusually complex or continuous inputs.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.impact: Resource exhaustion, degradation of service quality, system crashes, and unexpectedly high cloud API costs.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.mitigation: Implement strict rate limiting, restrict input size/length, and monitor resource consumption metrics.

OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.name: Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.description: Compromises arising from vulnerable third-party components, pre-trained models, datasets, or libraries used in the LLM ecosystem.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.impact: System compromise, data breaches, or arbitrary code execution originating from compromised dependencies.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.mitigation: Maintain a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), use trusted model repositories, and perform continuous vulnerability scanning on dependencies.

OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.name: Sensitive Information Disclosure
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.description: The LLM unintentionally revealing confidential data, Personally Identifiable Information (PII), or proprietary algorithms in its responses.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.impact: Severe privacy violations, legal non-compliance (e.g., GDPR), and exposure of corporate intellectual property.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.mitigation: Implement data scrubbing techniques, use strict system prompt constraints, and filter sensitive data from outputs.

OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.name: Insecure Plugin Design
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.description: LLM plugins or extensions having insecure API endpoints, lacking access controls, or failing to validate input received from the LLM.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.impact: Unauthorized actions executed by the LLM via vulnerable plugins, leading to privilege escalation or data manipulation.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.mitigation: Apply OWASP Top 10 API Security principles to all LLM plugins, enforce strict access controls, and use explicit user authorization.

OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.name: Excessive Agency
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.description: Granting the LLM excessive functionality, permissions, or autonomy to interface with other systems without adequate constraints.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.impact: Unintended, autonomous destructive actions such as deleting databases, sending unauthorized emails, or executing harmful system commands.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.mitigation: Implement the Principle of Least Privilege (PoLP), limit function calling capabilities, and require user confirmation for critical actions.

OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.name: Overreliance
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.description: Systems, developers, or users trusting LLM outputs blindly without proper verification or critical oversight.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.impact: Introduction of security vulnerabilities (via insecure generated code), spread of misinformation, and legal liabilities due to AI 'hallucinations'.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.mitigation: Cross-check LLM outputs with trusted sources, implement automated code scanning, and clearly communicate the AI's limitations to users.

OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.name: Model Theft
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.description: Unauthorized access, copying, or exfiltration of proprietary Large Language Models, their weights, or their architectures.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.impact: Loss of intellectual property, severe financial damage, and unauthorized use of the model by malicious actors.
OWASP_LLM_TOP_10.mitigation: Enforce strong network and access controls, use watermarking on model outputs, and continuously monitor API usage for extraction patterns.
